selfReview.placement: Top-center between portrait and minimap; left mode strip removed.
states: Collapsed / automation enabled, waiting for enemies, with separate stop control
selfReview.frame: Shared dark-gold fine double-line frame retained.
selfReview.text: Reviewed 自动操作, 寻路, 战斗, 挂机, 自动战斗·待敌, 停止 and behavior note.

limitations: Raster design only; actual touch geometry, viewport ratio, safe areas and runtime transitions remain to be implemented and verified.

interactionContract.expand: Reveal options without changing current automation state.
interactionContract.choose: Select a mode and collapse, then display actual state.
interactionContract.stop: Stop actual automation; never confuse stopping with collapse.
interactionContract.status: Derived from current automation mode, navigation target and actual status; distinguish enabled/waiting from fighting.
interactionContract.manualTakeover: Preserve existing rules: navigation pauses with explicit continuation; battle/idle assistance stops.
interactionContract.relaunch: Never auto-enable automation from the visual expansion preference.

implementation.pending: TapTap physical-device validation and user review of runtime art.
